column4: DONE 13 Sep 2026. column1: Find Luis Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico in Montevideo
column4: DONE 13 Sep 2026. Married 19 December 1864, San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo, act 258 - image read at full resolution. He is named as the legitimate son of Don Luis and Dona Justiniana Lenguas, which makes the Montevideo trunk PRIMARY where it had been a tree assertion. She is named as the daughter of Dr Don Candido Juanico and Dona Juliana Gonzalez. ORIGINAL NOTE: Their marriage, and his own baptism. If his father is the Don Luis Lerena who stood godfather by proxy in 1866, that is two generations from one act.

column1: Turn the Montevideo marriage-dispensation register, 1856-1932
column4: DONE the same night, by full-text search on the register's own formulae. EIGHT Lerena dispensations in seventy-six years - two families, the Montevideo patricians of the Catedral and the rural Lerenas of Trinidad in Flores. NO Juan Carlos Lerena, and NO Lerena-Lerena dispensation at all: every Lerena in the register marries out. That closes one branch of the question - if Maria was a Lerena by birth AND they married in Montevideo, a dispensation would exist. It does not. See data/montevideo-dispensations-lerena.tsv.
